integrity.mathematical_basis: Period reduction and exhaustive classification by zero, one or two transitions; direct finite cross-checks

scientific_limitations: The result applies to binary two-run periodic words and 2-Abelian factor signatures only. An unindexed equivalent specialization may exist; finite tests are not infinite proof.
title: Exact 2-Abelian complexity of two-run periodic binary words and a phase-identifiability threshold
